description: This file defines the 'Job' model for Mattermost, including job types, statuses, validation, and related methods, as well as the Worker interface.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Represents a background job with properties such as ID, type, status, progress, and timestamps.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of the job's properties for auditing purposes.

methods.name: MarshalYAML
methods.description: Serializes the Job object into YAML format.

methods.name: UnmarshalYAML
methods.description: Deserializes YAML data into a Job object.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the Job's ID, creation timestamp, and status.

methods.name: IsValidStatusChange
methods.description: Checks if a status change from the current status to a new status is valid.

methods.name: LogClone
methods.description: Returns a clone of the job's audit data.
